exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Oxygen saturation (SpO2) at 1, 5, and 10 minutes of life
finding: Newborns delivered by cesarean section had lower SpO2 levels in the first 10 minutes of life and took longer to reach SpO2 > 85% compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with lower oxygen saturation in newborns compared to vaginal delivery.
